title: ceropegia pauciflora
intro: Ceropegia pauciflora, commonly known as the "Gaster Flower" or "Oroblanco", is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and sore throat, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ceropegia pauciflora include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
